name: TC-373: opening a check births a DINE_IN CONFIRMED unpaid order with the table fields stamped
description: POST create-order {openCheck:true, tableName, guestCount} → 201. The backend forces orderType DINE_IN, status CONFIRMED (staff placing the order IS the acknowledgment — never PENDING), paymentStatus PENDING, and stamps tableId/tableNumber/guestCount/tabOpenedAt. The create response's orderNumber is the PERMANENT receipt number (legacy tablet wire name); dailyOrderNumber is the daily call number.
